name: COLDCARD
reason: Outside universe: self-custody hardware wallets. An RNG integration error in seed generation (firmware since March 2021) let attackers derive users' keys; confirmed thefts about $88.6M-$103M (BleepingComputer; Cointelegraph; Galaxy Research). Noted with LuBian and Wintermute as evidence that key generation is a separate failure class
